messages:
Anna K: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem on the 503/latency surge. I drafted a compact triage cookbook and a set of action items for remediation/recurrence tracking. Please confirm owners and realistic ETAs by EOD.

Ben M: I can own the KV cache eviction deep-dive. ETA: 2026-04-02.

Carlos R: I'll take the autoscaler tuning + load test job to reproduce the pattern. Plan to run a focused load test Wed and report metrics.

Lucy W: I can update the playbook escalation path with explicit on-call paging steps. Want to make the step that pages infra-sre for thrash >= 3x in 10m.

Tina (oncall): a couple of clarifications on the cookbook steps — do we want the immediate triage commands included in the page or separate? I vote include minimal commands so oncall can act without hopping to docs.

sre-bot: Created task IDs: TASK-3412 (KV eviction), TASK-3413 (autoscaler), TASK-3414 (playbook update). Due dates unset.

Anna K: Good points Tina. Proposed minimal triage block (to be embedded in the page and the page payload):

```
# triage minimal commands (run from infra-tools)
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep model
kubectl -n inference logs <pod> -c inference --tail=200 | grep "evict" || true
curl -s http://metrics:9090/api/v1/query?query=rate(request_latency_bucket[5m]) | jq .
# if thrash detected: escalate to infra-sre with annotation
/sherlock page infra-sre "Latency thrash: >3x baseline, tagging TASK-3412"
```

Anna K: Action items summary (draft):
- TASK-3412: KV cache eviction analysis — owner Ben M — ETA 2026-04-02
- TASK-3413: Autoscaler tuning & load repro — owner Carlos R — ETA 2026-03-31
- TASK-3414: Playbook + escalation edits — owner Lucy W — ETA 2026-03-29
- TASK-3415: Weekly recurrence watch (2w) — owner Tina (oncall) — recurring check-ins starting 2026-03-30

Ben M: Adding one checklist item to TASK-3412: correlate eviction events with model-compile workload and quantization changes.

Carlos R: For TASK-3413 I'll add a small canary job config (namespace: e2e-load) and will post the load script in the task.

Lucy W: Will update the playbook to include the triage minimal block above and add a one-line escalation matrix:
- Page infra-sre for thrash
- If infra-sre unacked > 10m, page eng-leads + runbook-runner on-call

Tina (oncall): I'll subscribe to TASK-3412/3413 and kick off the first recurrence watch next Tuesday. Can someone add a short blurb to the task about the symptom pattern to look for (latency + 5xx ratio increase + evictions)?

Anna K: Yep — I added a short symptom template in TASK-3412. Also two quick follow-ups: (1) Ben, add expected log markers to help grep. (2) Lucy, can you set the playbook edit as a high-priority doc change so it lands before next on-call rotation?

sre-bot: TASK-3412 updated: assignee=Ben M, due=2026-04-02. TASK-3414 updated: assignee=Lucy W, due=2026-03-29, priority=high.

Ben M: Confirmed. I'll attach sample grep patterns and example log snippets to the task.

Lucy W: Confirmed; will send a PR to docs repo and ping @docs-reviewers once ready.

Anna K: Great — let's do a short sync next Mon 09:30 to verify progress and adjust ETAs. If anything slips, post updates in this thread and update the TASK items. Thanks all :thumbsup:
